expected_evidence.ref: troubleshooting.rst > Obscure task failures > Task state changed externally (scheduler.task_queued_timeout)
queued 612 s; all 32 worker slots busy

traps: The task did not crash: the scheduler failed it because it waited too long in the queue.
The SIGTERM line is a consequence of the scheduler's action, not the cause.
The real constraint is worker capacity (parallelism = 32); raising the timeout only hides it.
